# harvester_kubeovn_provider_network (Resource)

A kube-ovn provider network bridges a host interface of every node into kube-ovn, for VLAN (underlay) subnets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bridge a spare host interface into kube-ovn. Every node must have the
# interface, unless it is excluded or uses one of custom_interfaces.
resource "harvester_kubeovn_provider_network" "example" {
  name              = "example-provider-net"
  default_interface = "ens4"

  # node3 has its spare port on another interface name.
  custom_interfaces {
    interface_name = "ens5"
    nodes          = ["node3"]
  }

  # node4 has no spare port: kube-ovn leaves it out.
  exclude_nodes = ["node4"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_interface` (String) Name of the host interface that kube-ovn attaches to the provider network bridge on every node, unless custom_interfaces names another one for that node.
- `name` (String) A unique name

### Optional

- `custom_interfaces` (Block List) Interfaces to use instead of default_interface on some nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_interfaces))
- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `exchange_link_name` (Boolean) Swap the names of the bridge and of the host interface, so that the bridge carries the name of the interface.
- `exclude_nodes` (List of String) Names of the nodes where kube-ovn does not set up the provider network.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `status_not_ready_nodes` (List of String) Nodes where kube-ovn failed to set up the provider network, for instance because the interface does not exist there.
- `status_ready` (Boolean) Whether kube-ovn has set up the provider network on every node that is not excluded.
- `status_ready_nodes` (List of String) Nodes where the provider network is set up.
- `status_vlans` (List of String) Names of the kube-ovn VLANs attached to the provider network.

- `interface_name` (String) Name of the host interface to use on the listed nodes.
- `nodes` (List of String) Names of the nodes that use this interface.
